name: Fire Training
summary:
The OneBonsai fire safety training teaches people how to combat fires using practical exercices. Participants learn the most important steps of evacuation. Learn to select the correct fire extinguishers (CO2, foam, powder, water) on the correct fire types (A-type fire, B-type fire, fire of electrical origin). 
Learn the PASS procedure: Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep. 
Try it out for free but please go to onebonsai.com or contact hello@onebonsai.com for more information.
